g.title: KayaRank2Convo3 begins.
g.text: KayaRank2Convo3 begins.

g.title: j3085560616
g.text: Could you explain the mechanics of ‘Protea’? I dug up some of her blueprint details and need confirmation.

g.title: j1196188076
g.text: No, I can't. [End].

g.title: j807256800
g.text: Explain her mechanics? I can try.

g.title: j2164993748
g.text: Protea? She's complicated.

g.title: j2189522063
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j1519621632
g.text: Throw.

g.title: j3187096188
g.text: I'm guessing you want to know about Temporal Anchor?

g.title: j2375691663
g.text: And not just because of what she can do, but because of where she came from.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank3Convo1.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank3Convo1.

g.title: j2189522063->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank3Convo1.
j2354029271
g.text: Throw?

g.title: j3155902922
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j2102086546
g.text: Whoever she was, what she is now is someone that served Parvos Granum.

g.title: j3503720430
g.text: Throw, then throw some more.

g.title: j3846288544
g.text: You asked.

g.title: j2499524569
g.text: Yep.

g.title: j1876074356
g.text: Yeah yeah, big bad guy with lots of money and brains. Same as always.

g.title: j1377951358
g.text: Ugh. Bye? Bye.

g.title: j2713235572
g.text: I asked, expecting answers about her Temporal affinity, at least from what I can see...

g.title: j4127669703
g.text: Right. Because Time Travel, or the appearance of some mastery of Temporal things.

g.title: j1459805773
g.text: You know the type?

g.title: j1410662539
g.text: He's not all bad but that's a pretty close read.

g.title: j37903632
g.text: He is responsible for a lot. Too much to list, but Protea is one of them.

g.title: j1623017773
g.text: Yep.

g.title: j261827983
g.text: Yep.

g.title: j4033660738
g.text: Whatever

g.title: j2293656428
g.text: So HE'S the one I should be talking to?

g.title: j86030318
g.text: Because for some reason, all there is to Nova is asking the only time traveller she knows about time travel.

g.title: j2702403996
g.text: Because you really won't give up? It's not like I want you to, but I really don't know how to help you.

g.title: j2396544380
g.text: The Dean of my university was like that. If I EVER see him again..

g.title: j1488211063
g.text: If you want to be kept as a science experiment for the rest of your life, sure.

g.title: j52831603
g.text: I don't think putting you in touch is a good idea, even if it were possible.

g.title: j1088350304
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j892965174
g.text: Protea, details. Like is there a me of her? You know like a half-baked freak?

g.title: j4171999014
g.text: I thought he would take my side but...

g.title: j4273042349
g.text: And sold to the highest bidder.

g.title: j4063958413
g.text: Let's try and stick to what could help you here.

g.title: j1840234009
g.text: Yep.

g.title: j3515803336
g.text: The half-baked freak that will solve time travel, though. Give yourself some credit.

g.title: j385974191
g.text: Protea the Warframe that we know of.

g.title: j2511316311
g.text: What happened to you in University?

g.title: j36177467
g.text: Take your side in what?

g.title: j2593228233
g.text: He's a smart man, not a good man. I don't think he'd be an ally.

g.title: j3300815063
g.text: Temporal... things.

g.title: j704375042
g.text: I'm SO glad you understand.

g.title: j1690846856
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1428174275
g.text: Sad for her.

g.title: j1616624991
g.text: Ugh let's leave it at 'Nova vs. The Internet'.

g.title: j394808038
g.text: Thinking.

g.title: j1281903982
g.text: What if I have questions about 1999?

g.title: j3088092432
g.text: Will I ever be allowed to ask you anything?

g.title: j4065175061
g.text: You're right.

g.title: j3960328672
g.text: But

g.title: j2621310940
g.text: Dumb dumb Nova.

g.title: j276302364
g.text: Hm. Well let's assume Protea has the most advanced Temporal grasp of all of these creations

g.title: j3312077439
g.text: Here's the deal and exactly how this is going to work.

g.title: j2030630325
g.text: Grades mean nothing if your teachers refuse to let you in class.

g.title: j2260840181
g.text: Is the grasp based on theory, science, innate ability, or.. hm.

g.title: j1039839706
g.text: I'm going to time travel, just like you did.

g.title: j3746127776
g.text: It's a different world now.

g.title: j2956008865
g.text: If you ever want to talk about it...

g.title: j540675539
g.text: Well hm. Actually. Yes let's say the Void has something to do with it.

g.title: j3603901143
g.text: I'm going to go to where YOU come from.

g.title: j242338677
g.text: I knowww I knoww...

g.title: j152261805
g.text: The Void isn't something you can just 'solve'.

g.title: j1418948748
g.text: The Void has something to do with... everything.

g.title: j4202693869
g.text: And then I'll know if you ever screw me over or if I can actually trust you, I'll know what the future holds.

g.title: j1006806605
g.text: Tell you what, once I figure out this 'time travel' thing, I'll tell you more. I'll have nothing to lose.

g.title: j4104951368
g.text: But it might be something that I can USE! Ha! Time to test something.

g.title: j3730010593
g.text: And it might just mean everything for me to start another test. SEE YA!

g.title: j2750386316
g.text: So, back to the books for me! Something about Protea... hm.

g.title: j2310554957
g.text: Wait, be careful!

g.title: j4088838641
g.text: Boolean KayaVoidTest is now true.
